d: Violence erupted in Germany after thousands of Gen Z protesters took to the streets across 34 cities, demanding better education, lower living costs and an end to compulsory military service. In Frankfurt, demonstrators looted stores and clashed with police, who used tear gas and water cannons to disperse crowds. Incidents were also reported in Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg. German authorities warned that extremist groups could exploit the movement. The protests come amid economic pressures on young Germans and a wider wave of youth-led demonstrations across Europe, including major protests…
